message:
Amara, Chidi and Dalia, the cooler must grow to cover staged field heat plus wall leak.

Plainly one daily lot cooling plus steady holding sets the size. The average pull-down is 1.04e3 W in the pull-down power (E57) plus 185 W wall leak in the steady load simulation (E31), so about 1.00e3 W cooling from a variable-speed Direct Current unit, where Direct Current (DC) means battery-type power, covers staged peak, like a small room air conditioner so plausible.

Amara, Chidi and Dalia, that cooling peak stays modest on electricity.

Plainly cooling divided by efficiency plus fans sets the wire size. The peak is 662 W in the peak power calculation (E60) at Coefficient of Performance near 2, where Coefficient of Performance (COP) means cooling per electricity, giving 13.8 A at 48 V in the peak current calculation (E61), like a small microwave on a household plug so ordinary solar cable carries it.

I am not ready, because the proposal (v1) still lists the old 300 W cooler and Chidi must revise it to the agreed 1.00e3 W peak before a vote.
